title: Realizing prescribed entropy functions by smooth diffeomorphisms of closed manifolds of dimension at least three
summary: Let $M$ be a closed smooth manifold of dimension $d\geq3$. Given a compact metrizable Choquet simplex $\mathscr S$ and a bounded nonnegative affine upper semicontinuous function $\mathfrak e$ on $\mathscr S$, we construct a $C^\infty$ diffeomorphism $h$ of $M$, isotopic to $\operatorname{id}_M$ and supported in an embedded $d$-dimensional solid torus $D^{d-1}\times S^1$, with an isolated minimal invariant Cantor set $K$.
